messages:
marta: quick follow-up from the gen-regression postmortem — consolidating remediation + test additions. can folks claim ownership for the items below?

kevin: happy to own the regression-suite additions. plan: add failing prompts to a focused promptset and create a nightly job. estimate 1.5w.

sasha: i'll take the load-test tuning and schedule a k6 run for peak qps patterns. need sample traffic profile from infra. @kevin can you dump the request distribution?

kevin: yes, i'll export the traffic histogram and put it in the ticket. gist will include percentiles and seq len buckets.

marta: high-level action list (from postmortem):
- add incident-driven promptset ("incident-top-100") + integrate into nightly regression
- create regression job that runs model variants (fp16, q4_0) against promptset
- add focused load test with observed traffic mix
- add chaos drill simulating KV cache eviction + pod restarts at peak
- define SLIs for prompt-level correctness regressions and alerting

arjun: for the promptset, we should capture the original seed + system messages so tests are deterministic. i'll attach a schema for prompt metadata.

marta: here's a minimal config snippet for the nightly job:```yaml
name: incident-nightly-regression
schedule: "0 3 * * *" # 3am UTC
targets:
  - model: rwd-open-7b
    quant: q4_0
  - model: rwd-open-7b
    quant: fp16
promptset: incident-top-100
reports: slack:#eng-ml, jira:ML-REGRESSIONS-POOL
```

liam: i'll wire the slack integration. can someone create the Jira ticket and list the initial sub-tasks?

kevin: created ML-REG-195 in Jira, sub-tasks: promptset ingest, nightly job, variant matrix, reporting hooks. link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ML-REG-195

sasha: chaos drill proposal: run a short window (10m) during off-peak that forces KV cache eviction and restarts 20% of inference pods while running a small load test. measure error rate and tail latency. would like to run first drill in 2 weeks (need approvals).

marta: sounds good. timeline proposals: promptset + nightly in 10 business days, load test tuning + schedule in 7 business days, chaos drill dry-run in 14 days. can owners confirm?

kevin: confirm for promptset + nightly (10 days). i'll include a checklist in the Jira.

arjun: confirm prompt metadata + deterministic seeds (7 days).

sasha: confirm load test + chaos plan (14 days). will draft runbook and rollback playbook.

oncall-bot: Incident ML-REG-183 auto-reminder: action items pending for 3 days — please update owners/timelines.

marta: great — final asks before i close the loop:
1) owners add acceptance criteria to Jira (simple pass/fail, sample size, lat thresholds)
2) put the nightly job as 'dry-run' for one week and post failures to #eng-ml-daily
3) schedule chaos drill calendar invite and notify eng-sre 72h prior

kevin: will add acceptance criteria: pass if top-100 prompts have >=95% token-match similarity and no P0 regressions; include automated diff artifacts.

liam: will set up dry-run channel and webhook.

marta: thanks — i'll follow up with a short PRD and link back into the postmortem. if anyone needs to change timelines ping me here. :thumbsup:

kevin: small note — add a test tag for model-variant sampling so nightly can limit cost spikes (e.g., sample 10% of heavy prompts at full context).

arjun: agreed, include seed and random-sampling config in promptset metadata.

sasha: tagging eng-sre: @oncall-bot can you confirm chaos drill baseline metrics access?

oncall-bot: eng-sre acknowledged. will provide baseline metrics and a contact for the exercise.

marta: ok closing this thread — summary pushed to ML-REG-195 and i'll add timeline tracker. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
